principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator: holds its own public-key encryption pair, verifies the authentication server's signed key binding, decrypts the responder's message, and encrypts the final confirmation for the responder.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the responder: holds its own public-key encryption pair, decrypts the initiator's request, verifies the authentication server's signed key binding, encrypts the nonce response, and checks the final confirmation.

principals.name: S
principals.description: the authentication server: holds its signing key pair and the registered public keys of the principals it serves, and signs public-key-to-identity bindings without generating fresh material or keeping request state.

values.name: SKas
values.description: SKas is the long-term private signing key assigned to S before the run.

values.name: PKas
values.description: PKas is the signature-verification key deterministically corresponding to SKas for S.

values.name: SKA
values.description: SKA is the long-term private decryption key assigned to A before the run.

values.name: PKA
values.description: PKA is the encryption key deterministically corresponding to SKA for A.

values.name: SKB
values.description: SKB is the long-term private decryption key assigned to B before the run.

values.name: PKB
values.description: PKB is the encryption key deterministically corresponding to SKB for B.
